thread_title: Biggest show in California this weekend, don't miss it!
breadcrumb: Biggest show in California this weekend, don't miss it!

posts.body_html:
The Bay Area CP Society annual show and sale is this Saturday, June 21, 2014 at the Garden Center at Lake Merrit, Oakland, CA! This is the biggest show and sale in California, so if you're in the area, don't miss it!

More details: www.bacps.org/show.html
